culture.title: Dye plants become cloth
culture.text: A 2021 interview follows Zhao Hui’s natural-dye workshop in Xinzhou’s old town. She collects materials including persimmon, walnut husks and bark, then dyes fabric for scarves, bags and tea mats. Her workshop connects a local streetscape with contemporary handmade textiles; it is not an identified recording site for the language study.

source.title: Xinzhou Daily · interview with Zhao Hui · 2021

culture.scope: Specific workshop in Xinzhou old town, not every local household.

culture.title: A hillside school in the old town
culture.text: Xiurong Academy occupies rising ground in Xinzhou’s old town. Its restored courtyards now combine historic architecture, exhibitions and cultural activities. The 2017 restoration forms part of the site’s present appearance; this city landmark is cultural context, not a known address of the pronunciation study’s speakers.
